get.description: Installed and cached APT candidate version (openhab or evcc)

post.description: Start package list refresh or upgrade one package (refresh, openhab, evcc)

get.description: Read active managed KNX gateway settings and live-action availability; OpenHAB runtime status is not queried.

200.description: Gateway state including gateway_ip, gateway_mode, saved_override, managed_path, things_format, reset_available, undo_available, and runtime_status=not_checked.

409.description: No usable successfully deployed KNX Things target is available.

post.description: Apply a validated IP address to the active managed KNX Things file and saved gateway override; runtime status is not checked.

ip_address.description: A non-empty IPv4 or IPv6 address.

200.description: Gateway configuration updated; runtime_status is not_checked.

409.description: No usable deployed target or unsupported live-update format.

post.description: Restore the last successfully deployed ETS gateway address or KNX router mode; runtime status is not checked.

200.description: Gateway configuration restored from the deployed ETS source.

409.description: No usable deployed target or ETS gateway source is available.

post.description: Undo the latest live gateway update only while its deployed target, managed-file digest, and saved override match the snapshot; runtime status is not checked.

200.description: The previous gateway file and saved override were restored.

409.description: No current or valid undo snapshot is available.
